messages.text: Functional cases match; I found Windows newline translation and am fixing byte-level stream parity.

commands.commandLine: powershell.exe -Command 'sh ./compile.sh; sh ./compile.sh; python -m py_compile zip_password_finder_port.py; $ref=(Get-Content REFERENCE_BINARY.txt -Raw).Trim(); cmd /d /c "executable.cmd --help > port.help"; cmd /d /c "`"$ref`" --help > ref.help"; cmd /d /c "fc /b ref.help port.help"; $helpCode=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output "help_fc=$helpCode"; $cases=@(@('"'-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','--mask','?1?1','-1','ab','-w','1'),@('-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-c','l','--minPasswordLen','2','--maxPasswordLen','2','--startingPassword','ab','-w','1'),@('-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','--mask','?d?d','-w','1'),@('-i','rust-reference/test-files/multi-file-with-dir.zip','-c','l','--minPasswordLen','1','--maxPasswordLen','2','--fileNumber','99','-w','1')); "'$n=0; foreach($a in $cases){$n++; $argline=($a|ForEach-Object{'"'\"'+"'$_+'"'\"'}) -join ' '; cmd /d /c \""'`"$ref`" $argline 1>r.out 2>r.err";$rc=$LASTEXITCODE; cmd /d /c "executable.cmd $argline 1>p.out 2>p.err";$pc=$LASTEXITCODE; $r=(Get-Content r.out|Where-Object{$_ -notlike '"'Time elapsed:*'}) -join \""'`n"; $p=(Get-Content p.out|Where-Object{$_ -notlike '"'Time elapsed:*'}) -join \""'`n"; $re=(Get-Content r.err) -join "`n";$pe=(Get-Content p.err) -join "`n"; Write-Output "case$n status=$rc/$pc stdout_match=$($r -ceq $p) stderr_match=$($re -ceq $pe) result=[$p]"}; Remove-Item port.help,ref.help,r.out,r.err,p.out,p.err'
